name: overflow
description: Delegate work to friends when your Codex allowance is running low.

interface.shortDescription: Keep working when Codex is nearly out.
interface.longDescription: Sign in once during installation. Then review and trust Overflow's SessionStart hook. At low allowance, your session coordinates while a friend's visible /earn task performs the work and returns it. Queueing and identity run remotely; Overflow starts no local broker or background runtime.
defaultPrompt: Use /earn to take one Overflow task.
